pr_title: Fix 2FA challenge and password challenge for non-database users
pr_body:
Fix #11685

Previous code (inspired by GitLab) handled 2FA *before* Devise performed its own authentication, duplicating the work, and, in case of non-database users (LDAP, PAM), doing the *wrong* kind of work. Now authentication is delegated to Devise/Warden, then once we have the user, we check the 2FA requirement, and handle OTP/recovery token.

Fix #11691

It is not possible to re-authenticate non-database users just from password input when confirming account deletion. So, for those users, use a simple username repetition challenge instead of confirming password.
pr_comments: How did this break PAM authentication...

issue_context.title: 2FA Challenge is not provided with LDAP authentication
issue_context.body:
### Expected behaviour

After login 2FA question should be provided

### Actual behaviour

Login without any 2FA is successful

### Steps to reproduce the problem

Setup LDAP auth in `.env.production`, login, enable OTP 2FA, logout
Than login again -> 2FA question not provided

### Specifications

Mastodon Version: v2.9.3

### Comments

There are no exceptions or warnings in the log.

review_comments:
Should we really set the resource before checking for OTP?
I wonder if we shouldn't move that to a warden authentication strategy?
It's fine to set resource... The sign in happens with the `sign_in` method.
